name: 映像スペクトルコヒーレンス解析
description: Measures spectral coherence between consecutive frames — AI-generated videos show distinct spectral jumps.
algorithm: Video Spectral Coherence分析アルゴリズム
mechanism:
This method analyzes spectral coherence across video frame regions for deepfake detection:

1. **Regionalスペクトル分析**: The spatial frequency spectrum is computed independently for multiple regions: face, background, clothing, hair. Each region's spectral characteristic — spectral slope, cutoff frequency, spectral peaks — is measured.

2. **Cross-領域スペクトルコヒーレンス**: All regions captured through the same optical system should show coherent spectral characteristics — same noise spectrum, same spectral cutoff (determined by the lens MTF), same compression artifacts. The method checks cross-region spectral coherence. Deepfake composites show spectral incoherence between generated face and captured background.

3. **スペクトルノイズFloorマッチング**: The spectral noise floor (high-frequency baseline noise level) should be uniform across the frame. The method compares noise floors between regions — different noise floors indicate content from different imaging/generation pipelines.

4. **スペクトルTransition分析**: At region boundaries (face-background border), the spectral transition should be smooth. The method analyzes spectral characteristics across boundaries — abrupt spectral changes at the face border (changing noise spectrum, changing spectral slope) indicate compositing.

5. **時間的スペクトルコヒーレンス**: The spectral relationship between regions should remain stable over time. The method tracks inter-region spectral ratios — temporal variation in the face-to-background spectral ratio indicates the face content varies independently from the background, consistent with deepfake generation.
parameters: 分析タイプ：自動統計\nスコア範囲：0（本物）から100（AI生成）
accuracy: 中〜高 — 入力品質に応じて70-85%の精度。
source: デジタルフォレンジックとAIコンテンツ検出の査読済み研究に基づく。
useCase: AI生成コンテンツを検出するためのマルチシグナル分析パイプラインの一部として使用。
strengths: • 研究に裏付けられた方法論\n• 高速な計算時間\n• 他の検出方法と相補的
limitations: • 精度は入力品質により変動\n• 他の方法と組み合わせて使用するのが最適

references.title: Frank, J. et al. (2020). Leveraging Frequency Analysis for Deep Fake Image Recognition. ICML.
Durall, R. et al. (2020). Watch Your Up-Convolution: CNN Based Generative Deep Neural Networks Are Failing to Reproduce Spectral Distributions. CVPR.
